title: If you want a visit with a passionate guide
text:
Very well organized tour with Marco as guide. He has adapted to the fact that we have a 7-month-old baby. 
Duration of the perfect visit. 
Very pleasant, friendly, Marco is passionate, he tells the story by living it. 
Thank you to him for this great time together.
author: sabsab2017

title: Truly Incredible
text: Just...wow. I wish it were possible to give more than 5 stars for this wonderful tour! My mother and I had such a great time with Carlos, our amazing guide. He was simply outstanding in every regard, and we felt so lucky to explore the Alhambra with him. All communication with Matias beforehand was prompt and thorough - much appreciated. This was truly the highlight of our time in Spain so far. Could not recommend more highly!!!
author: ophelias_prestige

title: Our guide, Edwardo, was enthusiastic, knowledgeable, and full of information. Could feel his love of the history.
text: Alone we would have never understood as much about Alhambra. It was easy and the reminders great, meeting place easy to find and the perfect amount of time. And Edwardo amazing guide!!
author: susi d

title: Magical Experience
text:
We were fortunate enough to have experienced a private tour with Debora who was incredibly knowledgeable, obviously very passionate of the history of the Alhambra and Granada, and is full of personality. Debora made our morning tour the best experience of our 6 week travels in Spain and Portugal.
Go early to beat the crowds and ask for Debora!
author: Cameron_B

title: Highly recommend this personalized tour
text:
Alhambra was on the bucket list. Just seeing the outside does not do it justice. The inside is where the real story is. Our guide was very knowledgeable, and personalized it for us. I would highly recommend – if your budget allows – to take a private rather than large group tour. The guide can adjust to your pace, answer your questions, and point out things, unique to you as a family, that would be of interest.
Eduardo was knowledgeable, nice, and excellent.
author: Shailen S

title: Unforgettable visit to Alhambra
text: He highly recommended this visit and especially doing it with a professional guide. There is no way you can say that you visited Granada and not make this visit
author: Happiness35904099797

title: Beautiful and informative tour through Alhambra
text:
Our family of 4 had traveled to Spain for a 10-day trip and an Alhambra tour was a "must see" during our visit.  Our main point of contact, Matias, was quick with replies and instructions leading up to our visit on May 16.  When the day arrived, we had an amazing, guided tour of Alhambra, Palaces and Generalife from our tour guide, Edu (Eduardo), as had been planned.  Edu is a local guide who lives in Granada and despite being a native Spanish speaker, has mastery of the English language and was able to describe nuanced details and history of the site without hesitation.

Edu met us punctually
author: W4182BOphill

title: Lifetime Dream Trip to the Alhambra Palace
text: We so enjoyed our experience with Edu at the Alhambra Palace. We learned so much about the history of the palace and its beautiful gardens as they evolved over the centuries. Having grown up in Granada studying history & landscaping at the university, Edu was a wealth of information. He went out of his way to make sure we had a fantastic time. Highly recommend Edu (and Matias at Tanat Travel for being so patient and helpful.)
author: Barbara_E

title: Fantastic guide and tour of the Alhambra
text: Our guide gave a fantastic tour. She was very knowledgeable, friendly, and gave us a great understanding and experience during our visit to the Alhambra. The site is so big we would have really missed out on seeing and learning a lot without our guide. Would recommend anyone visiting to use Yannat for their tour!
author: Flintlock47250

title: Alhambra brought to life.
text: Our guide Edu made our tour of Alhambra a very memorable experience.    He was very passionate about the history and the physical preservation of the site.  His easy going nature and story telling skills brought it to life for us.  We were pleasantly surprised at how cost effective the tour was.  Nothing beats a private tour customized to our pace and interests.   We highly recommend this company and Edu!
author: scottsB7418FW
